summary: Aermotor lookout on a Calhoun County hilltop, described in the present tense by the register; a 1935-36 student history credits CCC workers with a tower on Gauley Mountain, but the register gives no build date.

events.note: No year is given. A student account written in 1935-36 already describes the CCC-built towers, so the Gauley tower dates to no later than 1936 if it is the same one.
Registered June 26, 2022 as US 1622, MS 15, nominated by Jason Johns.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the build date as unknown. The 1935-36 student account credits CCC workers with two towers, one on Gauley Mountain, and gives no year. We read the Gauley tower as built by 1936 at the latest, but only if it is the same tower.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. Linking the register's Gauley tower to the Gauley Mountain tower in the 1935-36 account is an inference from the shared name; the register does not mention the CCC. The msgw.org https certificate has expired, so the page was read and cited over http. The record's material 'steel' is not in the register, which says only Aermotor; consider null. Facebook posts about the tower came up in search but were not read. Do not confuse with the Gauley Mountain tower site in West Virginia (FFLOS).
